paragraphs.text: Christ has prepared him a Church.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, many chief supports and principal parts of his Church, as were the patriarchs, prophets, apostles, pastors and teachers.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He compares wisdom with great princes who keep open house for all who come.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Meaning, true preachers, who are not infected with man's wisdom.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He who knows his own ignorance, and is void of malice.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: By meat and drink is meant the word of God, and the ministration of the sacraments, by which God nourishes his servants in his house which is the Church.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: For the wicked will contemn him and labour to defame him.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Meaning them who are incorrigible, which Christ calls dogs and swine: or he speaks this in comparison, not that the wicked should not be rebuked, but he shows their malice, and the small hope of the profit.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: He shows what true understanding is, to know the will of God in his word which is meant by holy things.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: You will have the chief profit and convenience of it.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: By the foolish woman, some understand the wicked preachers, who counterfeit the word of God: as appears in Pr 9:16 which were the words of the true preachers as in Pr 9:4 but their doctrine is as stolen waters: meaning that they are men's traditions, which are more pleasant to the flesh than the word of God, and therefore they themselves boast of it.
paragraphs.label: l
